channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: White House Threatens Congress, Saying Aggressive Investigations Could Be Crime
item.description: As Democrats prepared to begin oversight inquiries, it was not clear what legal basis could support the threat. The Constitution grants lawmakers immunity for legislative acts.

item.title: NPR: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
item.description: Senegal's breakdancers have been practicing for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games this month. It's the first time Africa is hosting an Olympic event.

item.title: BBC News: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
